predictions: Dang, we dumped TWO matches to forfeit last week, leaving us only 23 matches on the week. Posted a decent 17-6 record in those, which brings me to 220-101 (68.5% correct) for the season. Geez, I sure would love to finish with a season-best 23-2 in this last week, as that number would bring me above 70% for the season. Unfortunately, C division still exists, which basically means my shot at some hot week is toast.

Match of the week: (C Div.) Nine Lives @ The Outlaws. The good news for The Outlaws is that the C title chase is entirely in their control. All they have to do is win tonight, and the division crown is theirs. The bad news is they have to face one of the RDL's longest-standing upset masters in the Niners. I've written here that the Niners can beat or lose to anyone for years. Because they can. Outlaws escape, 14-10.

Match #2: (F Div.) Bottoms Up @ Armed & Hammered. With the Ducks now tied with them in points (and facing a team even lower in the standings than the Bottoms' opponent), the Bottoms had better take care of their business. But Armed is a pretty scary hurdle (who torched the Ducks back in week 6 themselves). Bottoms hold on, 14-10.

Match #3: (G Div.) Dart Knights @ Triple Shot. With their huge point lead, the Knights just need to win tonight by literally any score. And they get to face the sixth place team. What could possibly go wrong? Well, this sixth place team beat them seven weeks ago… Knights, 16-8.

Match #4: (F Div.) Nein Mark @ Duck Duck Groove. If Bottoms Up slips up in match #2 above, the F championship door opens right up for the Ducks to fly through. Any win with at least as many points as the Bottoms get is enough if the Bottoms lose tonight. Ducks, 15-9.

Match #5: (G Div.) 21 Dart Salute @ The Dartifacts. Well, if the Dart Knights meet the same fate in match #4 above that they met seven Darty Minds tonight, an In The Hall win could be moving them up into 2nd for the season (and likely A div. in the spring!). Hall, 13-11.

Match #7: (A Div.) Dart Attack @ Show Me Your Tips. Show Me is racing Talladega for 3rd for the season. Or is Attack hoping for their own win and some help that would push them to 3rd instead? Quite the finish if Serious helps tonight. Show Me hangs on, 13-11.

Match #8: (B Div.) Consistently Inconsistent @ Darty Minds. It's quite possible Inconsistent needs to pull the big upset here if they want to say in 2nd and make the jump to A. Alas, it's Darty, 14-10.
Match #9: (A Div.) Talladega Flights @ Why So Serious? See the match #7 stuff above? Well, Talladega ends that drama here, 16-8.

Matches #10 & #11: (E Div.) Bangin The Wire @ Dirty Darts Done Dirt Cheap; She-nanigans @ Rippin Darts. At first, it looks like Rippin is way too far behind for this to be a true race for 2nd. But Bangin faces the Dirty Dart juggernaut, while Rippin draws the last place team. Bangin falls, but only 16-8; while Rippin wins, 15-9.

Match #12: (A Div.) Lunatic Fringe @ Brave the Elements. Nope, no effect on the A race in this one, but it's still the league's top two teams. Preview of the tournament final, right? Element holds, 15-9.
And the remaining 13 matches, sorted by division:
B Division: Hump Day! 15, Shooter McGavin 9.
C Division: Bandits 14, Off Constantly 10; Idiots 14, Sanchez 10.
D Division: Rif Raf 14, Red-eye Rangers 10; Wing & A Plaque 14, Menace 2 Sobriety 10; Dart Side of the Moon 13, Ton 80 Proof 11; Liquor Posse 14, Irish Ton 10.
E Division: Cheapies 13, Machine 11; Corks 14, Death Throw 10.
F Division: Shooters 13, Sofa Kings 11; She Said 15, Coach 9.
G Division: Dartness 12+, Your 6 12 (again); Throw It 13, Bright 11.
